- Set die design standards, tolerancing and tooling specifications for high strokes-per-minute lines
- Work with motor design in concept development so slot profiles, segment interfaces and lamination geometry are manufacturable

- Manage supplier die programs from RFQ and design review through tryout and production approval

- Define quality plans for geometry, burr height, flatness and interlock integrity, with SPC at high volume
- Specify presses, coil handling and in-line inspection, and support tryout, commissioning and ramp at suppliers and Tesla sites

- Progressive die design for high-speed stamping, including strip layout, station sequencing and components such as punches, dies, pilots, lifters and cams

- Stator lamination or laminated core manufacturing, including segment geometry, interlocking and stack assembly
